The '''Sanctuary system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] safe [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]]. The system was connected to the [[Hinakuu system/Legends|Hinakuu system]] by the [[Tidal Circuit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].
